question: What foundational support did Śrī Kṛṣṇa rely upon according to this teaching?
premises: Śrī Kṛṣṇa is named as the subject.
He resorted to the mātṛkā letters.
This reliance is stated directly to the Goddess.
inference: Śrī Kṛṣṇa relied upon the letters of the mātṛkā.
plain_english: O lotus-faced one, Śrī Kṛṣṇa resorted to the letters of the mātṛkā.
